urlHelp: The CMS root, without the /api suffix
clientIdHelp: From Administration -> Applications in the CMS. The application must allow the client_credentials grant.
clientSecretHelp: The secret value, not the secret ID
layoutFolderHelp: Only offer layouts in this CMS folder and below. Leave empty for every layout in the CMS.
defaultChangeDurationHelp: How long a layout stays before the display returns to its schedule. 0 means it stays until reverted.
inventoryPollIntervalHelp: How often to re-read display groups and layouts
statusPollIntervalHelp: How often to re-read which displays are online and what they are showing
requestTimeoutHelp: How long to wait for the CMS before giving up on a request
layoutPlayModeLabel: How a layout reaches the player
layoutPlayModeHelp: Schedule works on any player and takes a few seconds. The XMR action is instant but is silently ignored by players that do not implement it, including Arexibo and gaxibo.
layoutPlayModeSchedule: Schedule a priority event, then collect (works everywhere)
layoutPlayModeAction: XMR changeLayout action (official Xibo player only)
schedulePriorityHelp: Priority of the events this adapter creates, and the marker for the ones it owns and replaces. Must be higher than any other event it should override, and used by nothing else.
inventoryCollectionsHelp: Each selected collection gets an inventory.<name>Json state and a count. The ones off by default are either large (the media library, widget modules) or hold personal data (users, user groups, active sessions). Anything left unselected is still reachable with sendTo("xibo.0", "api", { method, path }).
